verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close documents AI agents that review transactions and surface discrepancies during the month-end process. That is first-party, agent-driven flagging before the close. The MCP integration also exposes transactions and spending metrics to an external agent. However, nothing documents duplicate-transaction detection or spend-anomaly detection specifically, nor continuous monitoring as opposed to running a close workflow. Missing for 10: explicit duplicate-transaction detection, spend-anomaly flagging, ongoing/scheduled monitoring rather than a one-off close run, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
revenue/expense/spending metrics and ledger accounts, connected at https://app.puzzle.io/mcp
